// Known-bad code for the Semgrep rules (tools/security-scan/semgrep/rules.yml). Each line marked `expect:` must be
// found by that rule. The tests copy this file to a temporary folder as bad.ts; it is never compiled or run.
import * as child_process from "node:child_process";
import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createHash, createCipher, createCipheriv } from "node:crypto";
import * as fs from "node:fs";
import * as vm from "node:vm";

export async function sql(client: any, pool: any, householdId: string, name: string) {
  await client.query(`SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = '${name}'`); // expect: ws-sql-template-interpolation
  await pool.query({ text: `DELETE FROM accounts WHERE id = ${householdId}` }); // expect: ws-sql-template-interpolation
  await client.query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = '" + name + "'"); // expect: ws-sql-string-concatenation
}

export function code(input: string) {
  eval(input); // expect: ws-eval
  return new Function("a", input); // expect: ws-eval
}

export function sandbox(input: string) {
  return vm.runInNewContext(input); // expect: ws-eval
}

export function shell(file: string) {
  child_process.exec(`convert ${file} out.png`); // expect: ws-child-process-shell
  child_process.spawn("convert", [file], { shell: true }); // expect: ws-child-process-shell
  execSync("rm -rf " + file); // expect: ws-child-process-shell
}

export function download(req: any) {
  const p = "/data/" + req.params.name;
  return fs.readFileSync(p); // expect: ws-request-to-filesystem-path
}

export function back(req: any, reply: any) {
  return reply.redirect(req.query.next); // expect: ws-request-to-redirect
}

export function render(el: any, html: string) {
  el.innerHTML = html; // expect: ws-dom-html-sink
}

export const agent = { rejectUnauthorized: false }; // expect: ws-tls-verification-disabled

export function digest(data: string) {
  return createHash("md5").update(data).digest("hex"); // expect: ws-weak-hash
}

export function encrypt(key: Buffer, iv: Buffer) {
  createCipher("aes-256-cbc", key); // expect: ws-weak-cipher
  return createCipheriv("aes-256-ecb", key, iv); // expect: ws-weak-cipher
}

export const config = { password: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" }; // expect: ws-hardcoded-secret-assignment

export async function moduleOwner(db: any, name: string) {
  await db.owner.query(`SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = '${name}'`); // expect: ws-sql-template-interpolation
  await db.owner.query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = '" + name + "'"); // expect: ws-sql-string-concatenation
}
